items.title: Howard Johnson interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 14, 2019
items.q: And that was my first recording, was with Ernie Wilkins.

ctx.x: Well I was looking for him around the same time I was looking for Mingus, because all I wanted to do was meet these guys you know. Ernie Wilkins, who did the great arrangement of “Every Day I Have the Blues,” I met him someplace, and he actually said he didn’t use tuba anymore. And I said, “Well you have to hear me.” He said, “Well fine.” He’d given the tuba to use in every context and it was all right much of the time but it was mostly wanting. So he didn’t want to hear me play. So I got his phone number and…
Oh that’s great. © Fillius Jazz Archive -11-
